response.sql:
WITH source_counts AS (
  SELECT
    p.fundflux,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count
  FROM scanspatial AS ss
  JOIN projects AS p
    ON p.arcregistry = ss.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
summary AS (
  SELECT
    fundflux,
    project_count,
    project_count::numeric / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS share,
    AVG(project_count) OVER () AS average_count
  FROM source_counts
)
SELECT
  fundflux,
  project_count,
  share,
  project_count - average_count AS above_average
FROM summary
WHERE project_count > average_count;

assumptions.assumption: Funding sources with no matching spatial records are excluded; the average and total share denominator use sources represented by at least one matched spatial record.
